name: Modern Cover Letter
description: Clean, contemporary design with a subtle accent bar and concise layout

subject.name: subject
subject.label: Subject Line
subject.default: Application for Senior Software Engineer Position

body_first.name: body_first
body_first.label: Body Paragraph 1
body_first.default: I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Senior Software Engineer position at TechCorp. With over eight years of experience delivering high-scale distributed systems and a track record of leading cross-functional teams, I am confident I can make an immediate impact on your engineering organisation.

body_second.name: body_second
body_second.label: Body Paragraph 2
body_second.default: Most recently at ScaleUp Inc., I architected a real-time data pipeline processing 10M+ events daily, reducing latency by 60% and infrastructure costs by 35%. I championed a migration from monolithic to microservice architecture that improved deployment frequency from weekly to multiple times per day, all while maintaining 99.95% uptime. I also mentored four junior engineers and established pair-programming practices that lifted team velocity by 25%.

closing.name: closing
closing.label: Closing Statement
closing.default: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience in building resilient systems and leading engineering teams aligns with TechCorp's ambitious roadmap. Thank you for your time and consideration.
